scores.claim_text: U.S. government generated $257.0M revenue in FY2025 (29% of total) under EMSS contract ($738.5M / 7yr, $110.5M/yr fixed) signed Sept 2019, ending Sept 2026.

supports.M_value: Iridium recipient: n_awards=39, total $1.39B obligated. Award HC101319C0006 to IRIDIUM GOVERNMENT SERVICES LLC = $683,249,999.99 'AIRTIME SERVICES' from DoD (the EMSS contract). Award HC104714C4000 to IRIDIUM SATELLITE LLC = $484,593,998.74 'SATELLITE COMMUNICATION SERVICES' (prior-generation EMSS). HC101319C0003 = $60.5M GMSSA (gateway maintenance). 24 of 39 awards = DoD.
DoD-restricted query confirms primary federal counterparty is DoW/DoD — matches narrative.

scores.M_check: EMSS contract value $738.5M aligns with top USAspending award $683.25M 'AIRTIME SERVICES' (obligation-to-date typically below ceiling). Layer 3 Rule 7 satisfied — no contradiction.
scores.interpretation: EMSS contract verified. Material follow-on risk in Sept 2026 (re-compete), but this is a known/disclosed risk, not a misstatement.

scores.claim_text: Iridium NTN Direct (3GPP Release 19 standards-based NB-IoT / D2D service) expected to commercially launch in 2026 from existing constellation.

supports.M_value: 'NTN Direct' = 7 EDGAR hits: 5 IRDM filings (10-K 2026-02-12, DEF 14A 2026-04-02, 10-Q 2024-10-17, 8-K 2025-05-14, etc.) + one third-party 8-K from GCT Semiconductor Holding (2025-08-12) referencing the technology (chipset partner corroboration).
Iridium Satellite patents: 0 titles in 'NTN/3GPP/D2D/NB-IoT' categories — consistent with 3GPP standards-based implementation (no novel IP required), not necessarily a red flag.

scores.M_check: Phrase 'expected to commercially launch ... in 2026' is forward-looking — under Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational) with extra weight, this is a planned claim, not currently operational. Test-call/demo vs commercial-service distinction (Heuristic 9) matters.
scores.interpretation: MODERATE: pure NTN Direct stage = planned/imminent, not operational. Standards acceptance (3GPP R19) and chipset partner (GCT) corroborate technical readiness, but commercial service is not yet live. Track 2026 launch milestone.
